item.title: Gidgethub Is in Maintenance-Only Mode
item.description:
If you use gidgethub, here’s some news you may have missed: as of v6.0.0, released on September 25, 2026, the project is in maintenance-only mode.

What that means in practice:

  • Bug reports are welcome. We’ll make a best-effort attempt at fixing them.
  • Feature requests are not accepted, and will be closed.
  • Pull requests from external contributors are not accepted. Only maintainers can open them.

It still works, it still gets bug fixes, and v6.0.0 was a big release. It just isn’t growing anymore.

item.title: The PyLadiesCon Portal Was Spammed: 2,249 Fake Accounts. Four Months Before Anyone Noticed
item.description:
PyLadiesCon Portal

PyLadiesCon is a free, online conference run entirely by volunteers. The PyLadiesCon portal is where that work happens: it is where volunteers sign up and tell us how they want to help, and where the organizing team keeps track of teams, tasks, and who has been reached. It replaced the pile of Google Forms and spreadsheets we used to run the conference on, which is the story I told in my talk No More Spreadsheets at various conferences this year (PyCascades, LFNW, PyCon US, and PyCon Portugal).
